interface.name: applestia_glass_shapes_manager_v1
interface.description: Optional rendering hints. Withdrawal of this global makes its existing managers and shapes objects permanently inert; clients must rebind a new global to resume. In-flight requests remain valid no-ops, not errors.

request.name: get_shapes
request.description: At most one active object is associated with a surface. A duplicate request creates an inert object rather than disconnecting the client. The initial list is empty. Destroying the surface makes this object inert.

event.name: finished

description.summary: this manager and its shapes are now inert

event.description: The compositor has withdrawn this generation of the protocol global. Clients should release their objects and wait for a new global.

interface.name: applestia_glass_shapes_v1

description.summary: double-buffered glass shapes for a surface

interface.description: All geometry is in surface-local logical pixels. Pending state is snapshotted on wl_surface.commit and latched only when that commit is applied, including synchronized subsurface ancestor-commit timing. Requests never commit the surface themselves. Values are sanitized as hints, never rejected with protocol errors. The maximum list size is 128.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Discards pending and committed hints immediately. Other shapes objects are unaffected; a new active object may now be obtained for the surface.

request.name: begin
request.description: Clears the pending list only. Existing committed shapes remain until the surface's next applied commit. Subsequent add_shape requests append. Resets the optional clip/opacity annotation target.

request.name: add_shape
request.description: Nonpositive sizes are ignored; coordinates and sizes are bounded to sane compositor limits. Negative radii become zero; all radii scale proportionally by the CSS border-radius rule to prevent overlap. Depth is bounded, tint is RGBA8888, and unknown/invalid preset names fall back to compositor defaults. Shapes beyond the cap are ignored. New shapes have opacity one and no additional clip. If this add is ignored, subsequent set_clip/set_opacity requests are no-ops until another add_shape is accepted; they cannot annotate an earlier shape still in the pending list.

request.name: clear
request.description: Equivalent to begin. An empty committed list explicitly means no shapes. Resets the optional clip/opacity annotation target.

request.name: set_clip

description.summary: flat clip for the last pending shape

request.description: Optional annotation for the most recent add_shape, if accepted; no-op after a rejected add_shape or begin/clear until a new add is accepted. This rectangle clips the original rounded shape without inventing rounded lens edges at the clipping boundary. Nonpositive extents make the clip empty.

request.name: set_opacity

description.summary: opacity for the last pending shape

request.description: Optional annotation for the most recent add_shape, if accepted; no-op after a rejected add_shape or begin/clear until a new add is accepted. Clamped to zero through one; fades refraction and specular as well as the tint.
